Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service

Class NewsletterService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service.NewsletterService
All Implemented Interfaces:
GenerateNewsletterUseCase, IngestArticlesUseCase
public class NewsletterService extends Object implements IngestArticlesUseCase, GenerateNewsletterUseCase
Application service that implements both inbound use-case ports.

All article state is held in-memory for the duration of a request cycle (the articlesByRunId map). Slice 2 introduces JPA persistence for articles via ArticleIngestionPort; the map remains for transient ingest → generate handoff within a single server session.

When generate(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.NewsletterTone, int, boolean, int) completes, the resulting NewsletterDraft is rendered to HTML and plain text by NewsletterRenderer, then saved as a NewsletterRun via NewsletterRunPort for the subscriber archive. The in-memory draftByDraftId map is also retained so that getDraft(java.lang.String) can return the full draft (with sections and articles) in the same server session without a round-trip to the DB.

This class carries no Spring annotations; AppConfig wires it as a @Bean so the application layer remains framework-free and trivially testable without a Spring context.

      Parameters:
      runId - The ingestion run ID whose articles should be summarized.
      draftId - Unique identifier to assign to the resulting draft.

      maxSectionsPerTopic - Maximum number of sections to generate per topic.
      ragEnabled - When true, retrieves similar past articles from the vector store to enrich each section's prompt.
